S0.label: Explicit machine or template fingerprint
S0.description: Unedited generator artifacts, placeholder links, fake domains, agent config leftovers, or lorem ipsum.

S1.label: High-confidence AI tell
S1.description: Cliche marketing vocabulary, default indigo-violet-pink hero gradients, unmotivated three-card icon grids, or default framework titles.

S2.label: Medium-confidence structural or stylistic tell
S2.description: Uniform section rhythm, generic handler identifiers, redundant comments explaining syntax, or uncalibrated type scales.

S3.label: Soft stylistic signal
S3.description: Minor stylistic habits recorded in the audit report for review.
